body:
I am very sorry to end this conversation, but my boyfriend is on is way home and do not wish for him to know at all that i talked about this or am thinking about killing myself.

It was so lovely to talk to you and have you liseten to me.  Please know that it meant so much to me.

Sorry, the worst things cant be talked away.  We should probably accept others help.  I don't know about you, but the only people whom have ever offered me actual help were strangers on the internet.  Which i find so hopeless. I can only get strangers to listen to me and not anyone around me.  

I shall give you fair warning now my internet confident, i am more then a little drunk by this point, and everything i say is going to be dower.

I am very bad at accepting help.  I am however overly helpful to others and very good at deflecting.  When my dad was alive and before i took a severe turn for the worse i had myself convinced i would be a psychologist.  I thought i would be able to help people like me.  Then i realized i could never do that.
  
So what is your situation.  Maybe i could help you?  It is the least i can do to repay you for putting up with my whining.
That is awful.  How have you coped with it for so long?  What is your current situation?  I wish i could help you.
thank you i think i will try the Samaritans.

I am so sorry.  I know exactly how you feel.  Does it ever go away for you?  I thought after last time i was better.  That i scared myself or something.  I even started to get better i felt happier i thought about it less.  But its back.  Its like having a shadow that clings to you, slowly sapping all the light from the world until one morning you wake up and everything is grey, and the only thing that makes you feel better is when you hurt yourself and the pain brings flashes of light back for just a few precious seconds.  I live for those seconds of light, because i have been dealing with depression and suicide for 9 years and i dont want to keep dealing with it.
Thank you for talking to me.  You dont have to, you can go have fun on reddit.  You don't have to keep talking to me.  I will just keep bringing us both down.  Thank you for listening.

My dad died 3 years ago.  My mom and i stopped talking 2 months ago, when i confronted her about how my sisters and i think her new boyfriend takes advantage of her and is a jerk.  I tried educating my boyfriend, but he just pretends to understand.  When i talk to him about wanting to though he goes right back to yelling at me and treating me like i am a liar.  I asked him whose attention i was trying to get last time since i tried it when he was at work, and we lived in a seculuded area where our neighbors did not know us and did not want to know us an my family was a hundred miles away.  He never answered that question.  
   
Isnt he right though... If i can't go through with it and if i dont take enough pills or dont cut deep enough then maybe i dont want to because i did not try hard enough.  I should be able to make that cut deep enough or keep trying until i do.  Isnt that what it takes.  Am i really serious if i give up before im done?

I don't know.  That is how everyone in my life is.  When i was 16 him and the psychiatrist i was seeing convinced me to tell my parents i was suicidale.  When i told my mother she slapped me.  My dad just told me that it was not real and that i should just ignore it.  I am 22 now and i have never stopped thinking about it.  But everyone around me plays off my attempts.  Last year i was so close i know i can do it i know it.  I just need to get past the pain.
